thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-9876 triggered (auth-service): elevated 401 rate across customer traffic. Severity: Sev2. Paging on-call: @rob_oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-9876

pagerduty: PD-9876 acknowledged by rob_oncall at 02:04 UTC

rob_oncall: Acked — seeing ~15x baseline 401s for /v1/generate and /v1/auth/validate. Cloudwatch spikes and internal metrics show signature verification failures. Posting first logs I grabbed.

rob_oncall: ``ERROR auth.svc: token validation failed: signature verification error (kid not found) - token.kid=proj-key-v3``

elaine: I'm on it. Jumping into key-rotation pipeline and JWKS cache. Any recent deploys?

ops_tom: I pushed a signing-key rotate to canary at 01:55 UTC but it should have been staged. Investigating whether commit included wrong kid label.

sam: Temporary customer impact: support queue reports ~10 customers with 401s, a few are on Dedicated. Posting a quick sample curl against our auth jwks endpoint: ``curl -s https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'`` returns only v1,v2 (no v3).

sanjay: @ops_tom that matches my local trace — the key-rotation job uploaded v3 to key-store but the JWKS cache worker didn't pick it up. Looking at worker logs: ``WARN jwks-cache: reload failed: timeout pulling from key-store (504)``. Could be network flakiness to KMS endpoint during the window.

support_ivy: Customer-facing triage: tickets flagged as "auth failing" are being consolidated here: https://docs.example/incident-9876 (internal). Ivy will DM customers that they are being routed to engineering.

rob_oncall: Plan: 1) revert signer config on canary to previous kid mapping (ops_tom) 2) force JWKS cache reload across edge (sanjay) 3) monitor 401 rate and ticket list 4) escalate if no improvement in 10m.

ops_tom: Rolling back canary signer now. Command: ``kubectl set env deploy/auth-signer SIGNING_KID=proj-key-v2 -n prod-canary && kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-signer -n prod-canary``

ops_tom: rollout restarted, canary pods back in 20s.

sanjay: Forcing JWKS cache reload on edges. Running: ``for node in $(cat edges); do curl -X PURGE https://$node/.well-known/jwks.json; done``. Also touched cache worker (systemctl restart jwks-cache.service). Logs after restart: ``INFO jwks-cache: reload succeeded, keys: v1,v2,v3``

sam: I'm still seeing a minority of requests failing — seems like edge CDN has TTL for JWKS of 60s, some nodes still serving stale copy. Purge jobs still in flight.

rob_oncall: Can we confirm token validation now? Sanjay, can you run a quick verify against a problematic token we have in the ticket?

sanjay: Verified locally after reload: ``jwt verify --jwks https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json --token <sample> -> OK (kid proj-key-v3)``

support_ivy: Customers list down from 12 to 3 active tickets; those remaining are on global CDN nodes. Ivy has reached out to the largest affected customer and offered a rollback window info.

incident-bot: Escalation: PD-9876 auto-escalated to L2 after 8m (no full mitigation).

ops_tom: Pushed a short-term mitigation: signer will now publish both v2 and v3 keys in the JWKS regardless of active signing key for 30m to avoid kid-not-found races. Patch applied: ``/ops/service/deployments/update-jwks.sh`` ran successfully.

sam: Metrics: 401 rate dropped from 15x -> 1.4x baseline over 7 minutes. Error budget impact contained.

rob_oncall: Good. Now doing a controlled validation sweep: checking sign/verify across regions and dedupe any stale CDN caches. If no regression in 15m we'll declare partial mitigation and begin customer notifications.

elaine: Root cause preliminary: key-rotation job succeeded writing new key to the key-store, but JWKS cache worker timed out pulling the new key due to transient 504 from KMS service. Because the signer switched to v3 quickly, client tokens with kid=v3 couldn't be validated where JWKS hadn't reloaded yet. Edge caches amplified the window.

support_ivy: Customer-facing note draft: "We've identified a transient issue in our token key propagation process that temporarily caused token validation errors for some customers. Services have been stabilized; we will follow up with details and mitigation steps." Posting draft to incident doc.

rob_oncall: Update: all regions show 401s within 5% of baseline now. Marking as "mitigated" in PD. I'll leave it open for postmortem tracking.

incident-bot: PD-9876 mitigated by rob_oncall at 02:29 UTC. Please file a postmortem and assign an owner.

elaine: I'll own the postmortem — will include timeline, KMS retry tuning, JWKS cache backoff, and CDN TTL changes. ETA for initial draft: EOD today.

ops_tom: Follow-ups: add async retry with jitter to JWKS cache loader; modify deploy to publish both old and new kids for a short grace period; add synthetic monitors to assert JWKS and token verification within 10s of rotation.

rob_oncall: Thanks team. If anyone has remaining customer escalations tag me. Closing the live thread — follow-up in #postmortems once doc is ready. :thumbsup:
